scope: Fixed same-artifact development comparison: binary versus probability that a contiguous collapsed[hey,nyx] occurs anywhere in the67-state window.
hypothesis: Correct the semantic event from an exact whole-window transcription to contiguous keyword occurrence with arbitrary surrounding symbols. Training-only diagnostics show some recovered positives but also a high neutral prior; require actual false-wake and recall validation rather than assuming a benefit.
rule: At each unchanged30ms step, use the same scalar p and67x6 logits from the frozen dual INT8 artifact. Sum all CTC paths whose collapsed tokens contain contiguous[hey1,nyx2], preserving blank0 and repeated-label collapse with arbitrary context before/after. Treatment is p*P_occurrence; control is the same invocation p. No score normalization, learned scale, alternate temporal window or extra threshold. Apply unchanged five-score smoothing and independent existing event latch.
validation: Read all and only existing validation feature rows and continuous validation arrays. Source reset/timebase, positive [-.10,+.80]s estimated-end window, negative any-score maxima, duration and event policy match the original evaluator. Retain all per-step clip scores/times and continuous arrays. Correlated variants and weak endpoint estimates remain explicitly limited.
advance: Require both rules to use the same INT8 artifact/invocations, source resets, validation exposure, timebase and event policy. The product must have zero continuous development events and at most1% worst engine and engine/corpus false fraction, plus at least3 macro-recall points over the matched binary comparator. Select comparator at best recall in the same strict gate, otherwise the2% zero-event gate, otherwise minimum-false zero-event point; if no zero-event point exists use its frozen.97 reference and require product worst-group false fraction no greater than that reference. This is development advancement only, not Hi ESP parity or firmware eligibility.
comparator: Apply the existing strict1%/zero-event gate helper to the matched same-artifact binary baseline, with its strict/two-percent/minimum-false-zero-event/frozen.97 fallback policy unchanged. Require at least3 macro-recall points of gain at an eligible product operating point. The old scalar export is context only because this dual model has a new training-only PTQ cache; do not claim its binary outputs replay byte-exact.
stop_policy: Run this separately frozen semantic rule once on the unchanged21-point development grid and gate. Retain the outcome; no score-scale/window/threshold sweep, validation-residual fitting, final/test inference or deployment. Training diagnostic and mathematical semantics motivate the rule; held-out errors are not imported into model fitting.
limits: Reused development features and previously observed populations, not independent acceptance. Chance occurrence grows with the window; uniform67-step six-class logits already give about.90247 occurrence probability, so this probability is not calibrated wake confidence. The same unoptimized full-history dual model has unmeasured P4 cost and physical latency. Require exact parent same-artifact binary clip/continuous replay and bind original scalar/background bytes. No fitting, new export/PTQ, source waveform access, playback, microphone, board/OTA, production device, PCM speed or audio producer change.
adapter_gate: Before development inference, replay all40 predeclared training sources through the bounded256-step adapter. Both scalar outputs and occurrence products must match the retained monolithic outputs exactly, including every startup/chunk step. Retain all replay details and require at least one source crossing a chunk boundary. This tests implementation, not quality.
